description: A React component implementing the 'Direct Trajectory' flow for a career navigation app. It displays recommended roles based on persona data, allows saving a target role, and shows gap analysis, requirements, and a roadmap with visual components.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to a trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array of strings, sanitized and filtered.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a stable role identifier string from a role object, handling various possible role attribute names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Derives a role title string from a role object, handling multiple attribute options.

methods.name: horizonWeeks
methods.description: Maps a TimeHorizon value to an approximate number of weeks.

methods.name: horizonLabel
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for a given TimeHorizon.

methods.name: intersectSet
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two string arrays, case-insensitive.

methods.name: differenceSet
methods.description: Returns items in the first array not present in the second, case-insensitive.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Aggregates unique skills from various nested schema fields within a persona object.

methods.name: extractRequiredSkills
methods.description: Extracts required skills from a role object.
